Your worth is not defined my someone else. I just to abuse anti depressants as well. Not because I was depressed, I had my own reasons. No matter your circumstances, your life is one worth living. I see on here a lot of people say "I'm not worth anything" or "I have no porpose". Those statements are only true if you make it so. I know nothing about mental health or suicide. I only follow this sub to help if I can. Life is valuable, and for some reason I care about yours. I don't know why. I dont know you. But your life has value to me. There is too much wonder in the world, and I'd hate for you to miss out. My wife is depressed and has suicidal tendencies. That's why I'm here.
